tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a new llms.txt file for a public website they name. Reads up to 15 public HTML pages of that one domain (start page, XML sitemap, internal links) and returns a ready-to-publish llms.txt draft in Markdown, plus a format validation score, the Lighthouse "Agentic Browsing"

tools.name: validate_llms_txt
tools.description: Use this when the user pastes the text of an llms.txt file and wants it checked or improved. Checks the text against the llmstxt.org format proposal: H1 title, summary blockquote, H2 sections, absolute Markdown links, duplicates, links to other domains, file size and update date. Returns a 0-100 sco

tools.name: check_published_llms_txt
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether a website already has an llms.txt, whether it is served correctly, or why PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse flags it. Requests exactly one URL, https://<domain>/llms.txt, and reports HTTP status, content type, redirects, the file content, the format validation and t

tools.name: check_lighthouse_agentic_browsing
tools.description: Use this when the user only wants to know whether a given llms.txt text passes the Lighthouse 13.3 "Agentic Browsing" audit (llms-txt). Applies exactly its three rules: an H1 exists, at least one Markdown link, more than 50 characters. On failure it returns Lighthouse's original message. Works only

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_llms_txt, validate_llms_txt, check_published_llms_txt, check_lighthouse_agentic_browsing · Private data: generate_llms_txt, validate_llms_txt, check_published_llms_txt · Public sink: generate_llms_txt · Destructive: generate_llms_txt, validate_llms_txt, check_published_llms_txt, check_lighthouse_agentic_browsing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_llms_txt, validate_llms_txt, check_published_llms_txt, check_lighthouse_agentic_browsing · Private data: generate_llms_txt, validate_llms_txt, check_published_llms_txt · Public sink: generate_llms_txt · Destructive: generate_llms_txt, validate_llms_txt, check_published_llms_txt, check_lighthouse_agentic_browsing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
